name: just-ping
description: Utility to perform a ICMP Ping from 30+ location worldwide.

name: down-or-not
description: Down or Not checks a website from 3 locations in the WatchMouse network and decides if a site is indeed down or not.

name: jolokia
description: JMX is a standard management solution that supports the W3C specification for Cross-Origin Resource Sharing and allows browsers to access resources that are located on a different server than the calling script is loaded from. Jolokia is a JMX-HTTP bridge that provides an alternative to JSR-160 connectors. It enhances JMX remote with features such as, bulk requests and fine grained security policies.

name: icinga-2
description: The Icinga 2 API allows you to manage configuration objects and resources in a simple, programmatic way using HTTP requests. It provides a way to start your infrastructure monitoring and includes; query, create, modify and delete config objects, perform actions and more. Icinga is an open source monitoring and metric solution system.

name: muninmx
description: MuninMX is a service for monitoring CPU usage, processes, load, memory, and more. It can scale to thousands of nodes without suffering IO or CPU problems, and it queries those nodes on a timescale measured in seconds rather than minutes. MuninMX also comes with custom plugins, alert notifications, and user permissions management capabilities.

name: instana
description: The Instana API enables the retrieval of key data points used to monitor and analyze applications in real time. Instana is a REST interface that offers metrics, search fields, snapshots, and events in JSON format. Instana monitors application performance and infrastructure components; changes due to code deployment are instantly discovered. Instana offers precise, high fidelity visibility with 1 second data granularity.

name: w3c-web-things-wot-scripting
description: The Web of Things (WoT) Scripting uses WoT interfaces to provide layered interoperability between Things. The W3C Web of Things (WoT) Scripting API is designed to facilitate script runs on a Thing for purposes of discovering and consuming other Things and to expose Things characterized by properties, actions, and events.

name: uptime
description: The Uptime REST service is a API interface to ensure optimal ease of integration and common web API standards, that provides developers with an overview of endpoints that are supported with HTTP methods available for JSON/Form URL Encoded or Multi-Part Form data values. Uptime provides IT infrastructure monitoring and notifications via application, email and SMS.

name: platform-trust-context
description: The Context API provides means to list available JSON-LD contexts of the Platform of Trust.The contexts define the semantic meaning of the keys in the responses from the APIs. When creating a new identity, choose which type of identity to create by choosing the correct context. The context will then define the attributes the identity can have.Context API:- aids to choose the correct context in determining identity type while creating a new identity.- aids to define attributes an identity can have.- aids to list all supported contexts.

name: uptimefu
description: UptimeFu is a website and server monitoring service. Users input their domain (or multiple domains) when they register and UptimeFu monitors their status for free. The monitoring system will send an email if a site or serverâ€™s status changes. Their RESTful API returns results the status updates in JSON. It informs users of the status and latency of their domain, and a timestamp of the last time it was checked.
